overall_assessment: The Searchright screening workflow implements a structurally sound governed review model with independent blinding, role-based adjudication, and append-only audit history. The single-primary-exclusion-reason contract and human-only full-text authority align with systematic-review standards. However, a systemic authorization bypass in the role-gate logic, disconnected criteria validation, and permissive self-amendment by screeners represent fundamental governance weaknesses that would prevent approval for production use without remediation.

findings.description: Systemic authorization bypass for unassigned principals. The role-check pattern in submit_inner (line 211), resolve (line 332), amend_decision (line 389), and rescreen_subject (line 454) allows any principal with NO role assignment to submit decisions, resolve conflicts, amend records, or trigger re-screens.
findings.recommendation: Invert the guard clauses to require an explicit role match.

findings.description: Criteria validation is disconnected from decision submission. validate_decision_against_criteria (line 596) is never called by validate_decision (line 1096) or submit_inner.
Screeners can amend their own prior decisions. amend_decision (line 389) authorizes both PolicyAdmin and Screener.
findings.recommendation: Restrict amendment authority to PolicyAdmin only.

findings.description: No automatic third-reviewer escalation for two-reviewer conflicts.
findings.recommendation: Introduce an escalation policy when reviewer count is exhausted and conflict remains.

findings.description: Incomplete EPPI-Reviewer interoperability. Only export exists; no import function.
findings.recommendation: Implement import path and align export with EPPI-Reviewer schema.

findings.description: Hardcoded blinding pseudonym destroys cross-record linkage.
Adjudication rule is non-enforceable free text.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a structured adjudication procedure enum.

findings.description: Covidence and Rayyan importers assign default reviewer IDs.
findings.recommendation: Require reviewer_id or generate unique deterministic identifiers.

calibration_notes: Other systematic-review methodologists will strongly agree with the core design. They will unequivocally agree that the systemic role-gate bypass and self-amendment by screeners are critical governance failures.
